title: Replay action-stream metamorphic equivalence

headless_runs.note: 9 synthetic Stage 6 cases, 13 fairysvoice-th6-001 Stage 4 cases, and 13 gensokyo-th6-804 Stage 6 cases were trace/state equivalent.

notes: Alternate replay encodings that expand to the same bounded action stream produced identical headless runtime traces and state projections.
The evaluator pads short replay action streams with zeroes when comparing bounded equivalence, matching the replay end-of-input semantics observed during testing.
This is a negative-control observation, not a bug candidate.
